title: Ethical issues in human–AI interaction
summary: A PRISMA-guided systematic review of 30 studies spanning digital humans, conversational agents and social robots. Work includes structured extraction, quality assessment and thematic synthesis, examining bias, privacy, safety and the gap between ethical principles and actionable design guidance. Final manuscript draft; not listed as a published paper.

title: Interpretable deep learning for brain tumour classification
summary: First-author research comparing a custom CNN with DenseNet121, VGG16 and ResNet50 using 7,023 brain MRI scans. DenseNet121 achieved 92% validation accuracy in the reported study. Grad-CAM, regional analysis and severity scoring supported interpretation. This is a research result, not evidence of clinical deployment.
role: First author; conceptualisation, experimental analysis, interpretation and manuscript preparation

title: Microwave imaging for stroke screening
summary: Co-developed a computational microwave-imaging framework for post-stroke screening using tissue dielectric-property differences, CST antenna/head-phantom simulation, signal analysis and MATLAB image reconstruction.

title: Research / PhD Preparation
